title: Improvement Registry atomic shard/index repair

source_provenance.notes: SI-0008 records central registry safe-compaction limitation

problem_or_opportunity: The canonical Improvement Registry is stored as a large minified whole-file JSON. Safe connector writes may require complete replacement, so SI-0008 was preserved as a separate shard rather than risking loss of existing candidates. This creates a divergence risk between central index and candidate shards.
proposed_mechanism: Evaluate and pilot a shard+index registry or transactional registry builder that loads canonical data, merges candidate shards, audits invariants, writes to a temporary artifact, validates IDs/references, and replaces current registry only after complete validation/readback. Never manually reconstruct the monolithic registry from summaries.
expected_benefit: Strengthens anti-loss guarantees and makes future self-improvement capture atomic, concurrency-safe and easier to audit.
next_action: Execute N31-N32: compare monolithic, shard+index and transactional builder approaches; select smallest safe migration; test with a copy/fixture before touching canonical registry.
notes: BOUNDED PILOT A under ANTI-BEDLAM. No canonical registry rewrite until fixture validation and readback prove zero data loss.
